explanation: A holy building dedicated to God, where people came to worship and offer gifts.
King of Israel and son of King David, known for his wisdom and wealth. He built the first temple in Jerusalem.
The ark of the covenant, a sacred chest that contained the stone tablets with the Ten Commandments, Aaron's staff, and a jar of manna.
Another name for the temple in Jerusalem, the place where God was present among his people.
A symbol of God's presence and protection, which covered the temple when the ark of the covenant was brought into the Most Holy Place.
Members of the tribe of Levi, chosen by God to serve as priests and musicians in the temple.
Praise songs and hymns sung by the Levites during worship services and ceremonies in the temple.
Gifts and sacrificial animals presented to God as a sign of gratitude, devotion, and obedience.
The innermost room of the temple, where the ark of the covenant was kept and where God's presence was strongest.
